description: Defines an interface 'StartStreamRequest' representing a request to start a streaming process, including methods to specify the burst size and timeout.

classes.name: StartStreamRequest
classes.description: An interface representing a command to initiate a stream, with parameters for burst size and timeout.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of elements to send per message.

methods.name: getTimeoutMillis
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration in milliseconds.
